name: Kimi Delta Attention · KDA
tagline: Apply fine-grained forgetting before delta correction.
description: Feature-wise decay first updates the memory, then a delta rule corrects the decayed state. The adaptation transfers only the KDA mixer, without the complete Kimi Linear hybrid architecture or MoE.
paperTitle: Kimi Linear: An Expressive, Efficient Attention Architecture
mechanism: Feature-wise state decay followed by a delta update
Causal convolution of width 4, Q/K L2 normalization, β and a learned decay bias
Trained with FLA chunk kernels (chunk 64) and a fused causal convolution; FP64 recurrent oracle checks
limitations: The KDA mixer only, without Kimi Linear's MLA layers or MoE. The repository keeps constant 0/−3 gate initialization rather than Kimi's. The published formal run is the restarted KDA v2; a generation state cache is not implemented.
